summary: The prepared register rules passed the auditor checklist and synthetic emulator tests. Authorization uses authenticated identity and saved business access; only owners can close. Create and close validate required fields and count totals, opening fields are immutable, claims prevent duplicate concurrent opens, and closed records cannot be changed or deleted. Counts and notes are bounded. All existing unrelated write restrictions and the named-database boundary remain. This local assessment is not a deployment or a guarantee about future POS integration.
